title: 🔥 Jesus Didn’t Need Mary’s Permission: Exposing The Chosen’s Reversal of Authority
paragraphs:
🔥 Jesus Didn’t Need Mary’s Permission: Exposing The Chosen’s Reversal of Authority
(The Chosen – Season 1, Episode 5: “The Wedding Gift”)

A quiet village.
A joyous wedding.
A wine shortage.
A mother worried.
A son hesitant.

Suddenly—divine pressure?
Mary leans in, gently insists, “They have no wine…”
Jesus sighs, hesitates, and eventually relents.
The miracle happens—not because He was ready, but because she asked.
That’s how The Chosen frames it.

Beautiful? Yes.
Emotional? Absolutely.
Biblical? Not even close.

Because the moment Jesus becomes the one being influenced, instead of the one who initiates,
He is no longer Lord—He is a pawn in someone else’s plan.

❓ READER QUESTION:
“Brother John, didn’t Mary ask Jesus to help? What’s wrong with her encouraging Him to act?”

Here’s the problem:
It’s not that Mary asked…
It’s that The Chosen makes it look like Jesus wouldn’t have moved unless she did.
That is not encouragement.
That is spiritual manipulation—and it reverses the divine hierarchy.

📖 MAIN BIBLE VERSE – John 2:4–5 (KJV):
“Jesus saith unto her, Woman, what have I to do with thee? mine hour is not yet come.
His mother saith unto the servants, Whatsoever he saith unto you, do it.”
Let’s break this down—with original Greek clarity:

📜 GREEK WORD ANALYSIS:
“Woman” – Greek: γύναι (gynai)
This is not disrespectful, but it is formal.
Jesus is distancing Himself as Son to operate as Messiah.

“What have I to do with thee?” – Greek: τί ἐμοὶ καὶ σοί (ti emoi kai soi)
Literally: “What to me and to you?”
A Hebrew idiom used throughout Scripture to mean:

“This is not your concern. This is not your authority.”
(See Judges 11:12, 2 Samuel 16:10, and Mark 5:7 for similar phrases.)

“Mine hour is not yet come.” – Greek: οὔπω ἥκει ἡ ὥρα μου (oupo hēkei hē hōra mou)
Meaning: The divine time has not arrived.
Jesus operated according to the Father’s timeline, not Mary’s emotions.

🔥 The real Jesus didn’t need a nudge.
🔥 He didn’t perform signs to avoid social awkwardness.
🔥 He declared the Father’s will, on the Father’s schedule, for the Father’s glory.

🚨 THE TRUTH: What This Blog Will Reveal
✔️ Why The Chosen’s Jesus looks pressured instead of prophetic
✔️ How Mary’s role is elevated dangerously close to Catholic dogma
✔️ The divine authority structure between Jesus and His earthly mother
✔️ How this scene opens the door for the Marian co-mediator lie
✔️ What the miracle of Cana was really about—and why it had nothing to do with Mary’s influence

THE CORE TRUTH – WHAT DOES THE BIBLE ACTUALLY SAY?
❓ READER QUESTION:
“Brother John, didn’t Mary’s request cause Jesus to act? Doesn’t that mean she had special influence?”
Let’s go straight to the Scriptures—not the screenplay.

The miracle at Cana was not about Mary’s pressure.
It was about Jesus’ glory—manifested at the appointed hour, not adjusted by maternal emotion.

📖 JOHN 2:1–11 (KJV):
“…the mother of Jesus was there: And both Jesus was called, and his disciples, to the marriage…
When they wanted wine, the mother of Jesus saith unto him, They have no wine.
Jesus saith unto her, Woman, what have I to do with thee? mine hour is not yet come.”

📜 BREAKING DOWN THE GREEK IN FULL CONTEXT:
1. “WOMAN” – GREEK: γύναι (gynai)
✔ Not a term of disrespect—but also not “Mom.”
✔ Jesus is now distancing Himself from familial ties to operate solely as Son of God.
📌 Same word Jesus used on the cross:

“Woman, behold thy son.” (John 19:26)
Even in death, He used formal messianic language—never emotional overtones.

2. “WHAT HAVE I TO DO WITH THEE?” – GREEK: τί ἐμοὶ καὶ σοί (ti emoi kai soi)
🔥 This phrase appears multiple times in the Bible—and always indicates a clear boundary of spiritual jurisdiction:
📖 Mark 5:7 – Demons to Jesus:

“What have I to do with thee, Jesus…?”
= We operate in separate realms.
📖 2 Samuel 16:10 – David rebukes his men:

“What have I to do with you…?”
= This is not your call.
💣 Jesus isn’t just being poetic—He’s saying:
“This is not your mission. You don’t direct My glory.”

3. “MINE HOUR IS NOT YET COME” – GREEK: οὔπω ἥκει ἡ ὥρα μου
✔ Jesus is referring to His timeline of revelation and exaltation
✔ Throughout John’s Gospel, “My hour” = the cross and glorification
✔ He was revealing His glory in divine increments, not by suggestion
📖 John 7:30 (KJV):
“…but no man laid hands on him, because his hour was not yet come.”
📖 John 12:23 (KJV):
“The hour is come, that the Son of man should be glorified.”

📌 The miracle wasn’t a favor for Mary.
It was a signpost of the kingdom—a foretaste of what was coming.

🔥 JESUS NEVER NEEDED PERMISSION TO MOVE IN POWER
✔ He didn’t need Mary’s emotional pressure
✔ He didn’t need social urgency
✔ He didn’t need public approval
He moved only when the Father willed—with divine foresight, not maternal prompting
📖 John 5:19 (KJV):
“The Son can do nothing of himself, but what he seeth the Father do…”

💣 The Chosen turns a messianic sign into a relational favor.
That’s not doctrine—that’s downgrade.

BIBLICAL & HISTORICAL PROOF – EARLY CHURCH ON JESUS' AUTHORITY & MARY'S POSITION
❓ READER QUESTION:
“Brother John, but isn’t Mary the intercessor who moved Jesus to do His first miracle?”

Only if you believe Catholic fiction.
The early Church, the Bible, and the Holy Spirit all testify:
✔ Jesus was always in control
✔ Mary was honored—but never authoritative
✔ The miracle at Cana pointed to Christ’s glory, not Mary’s intercession

📖 BIBLICAL PROOF: MARY HONORED, NEVER EXALTED
📌 Mary was blessed—not powerful.
Luke 1:28 (KJV):
“Hail, thou that art highly favoured, the Lord is with thee: blessed art thou among women.”

✔ “Favoured” – Greek: κεχαριτωμένη (kecharitōmenē) = one who has received grace, not one who dispenses it
✔ She received favor—she didn’t control divine decisions

📌 Mary knew her place in God’s plan.
Luke 1:38 (KJV):
“Behold the handmaid of the Lord; be it unto me according to thy word.”

✔ “Handmaid” – Greek: δούλη (doulē) = female slave or servant
✔ She saw herself as obedient to God’s will, not the influencer of it

📌 Jesus refused Marian interference.
Luke 11:27–28 (KJV):
“Blessed is the womb that bare thee… But he said, Yea rather, blessed are they that hear the word of God, and keep it.”
💣 Jesus corrected Marian exaltation in real time—redirecting all praise back to obedience and the Word.

📌 At Cana, Jesus rebuked, then performed the miracle anyway—not because of Mary, but to reveal His glory.
John 2:11 (KJV):
“This beginning of miracles did Jesus… and manifested forth his glory; and his disciples believed on him.”

📌 Greek: ἐφανέρωσεν τὴν δόξαν αὐτοῦ (ephanerōsen tēn doxan autou)
= "He manifested His own glory" — not Mary’s persuasion

🏛️ HISTORICAL PROOF – WHAT THE EARLY CHURCH BELIEVED
📜 JUSTIN MARTYR (c. 150 AD)
“Jesus performed miracles to reveal that He is the Son of God, not to answer men’s demands.”

No mention of Mary initiating signs.
Only Christ declaring His divinity.

📜 IRENAEUS – Against Heresies, Book III (c. 180 AD)
“Christ did not need man to testify of Him, for He was full of the Spirit and wisdom from the beginning.”
✔ Christ never needed prompting—not from man, not from Mary.

📜 TERTULLIAN – On the Flesh of Christ
“Mary gave Him flesh, not authority. She birthed Him, but He rules her.”
💣 The early Church never saw Mary as co-mediator or initiator. That’s a later Catholic invention, not early Christian doctrine.

💥 CONCLUSION:
✔ The miracle at Cana wasn’t a reaction—it was a revelation
✔ Jesus never submitted His mission to family ties
✔ Mary was not a door to miracles—Jesus is the Door (John 10:9)

OLD TESTAMENT PROPHECY – CHRIST MOVES BY THE FATHER’S WILL, NOT MARY’S REQUEST
❓ READER QUESTION:
“Brother John, is there prophecy that confirms Jesus couldn’t have been influenced by Mary?”
🔥 Yes. The Old Testament prophesied a Messiah who obeys only the voice of the Father, not the emotions of man—even those closest to Him.
Let’s break it down, verse by verse, with Hebrew insights.

📖 PROPHECY #1 – THE SON WHO DOES THE FATHER’S WILL
Isaiah 11:2–3 (KJV):

“And the spirit of the Lord shall rest upon him…
And shall make him of quick understanding in the fear of the Lord:
and he shall not judge after the sight of his eyes,
neither reprove after the hearing of his ears.”
📜 HEBREW ANALYSIS:

“Fear of the Lord” – Hebrew: יִרְאַת יְהוָה (yir’at YHWH)
= The Messiah would be driven by reverent obedience to God, not by the opinions or pressures of people.

💣 This prophecy alone proves:
Jesus wasn’t waiting for Mary—He was listening only to the Father.

📖 PROPHECY #2 – THE MESSIAH FOLLOWS A PRECISE TIMELINE
Daniel 9:25 (KJV):
“…from the going forth of the commandment… unto the Messiah the Prince…”
✔ The appearance of Christ and His actions were pre-appointed, not emotionally adjusted.

📖 PROPHECY #3 – THE MESSIAH’S WORK WAS ORDERED FROM HEAVEN
Psalm 40:7–8 (KJV):

“Then said I, Lo, I come: in the volume of the book it is written of me,
I delight to do thy will, O my God…”

📜 Hebrew: חֵפֶץ עֲשׂוֹת רְצוֹנֶךָ (chephets asot r’tzonkha)
= “I delight in doing Your will”—not man’s, not Mary’s, not the crowd’s.
🔥 Jesus came to fulfill prophecy, not fulfill party favors at a wedding.

📖 PROPHECY #4 – HE IS THE KING, NOT THE COORDINATED
Isaiah 9:6–7 (KJV):

“…and the government shall be upon his shoulder…
Of the increase of his government and peace there shall be no end…”

✔️ He governs.
✔️ He initiates.
✔️ He doesn’t get pressured into miracles.

💥 CONCLUSION:
✔ The Messiah was foretold as obedient to the Father—never emotionally swayed
✔ Every step of Jesus’ ministry fulfilled prophetic timing
✔ The miracle at Cana wasn’t a favor for Mary—it was a fulfillment of divine preordination

TESTIMONY – “I WAS RAISED TO BELIEVE MARY COULD CHANGE JESUS’ MIND”
❓ READER QUESTION:
“Brother John, does it really matter if we believe Mary had special influence? Doesn’t it still lead us to Jesus?”
Let me tell you about Lourdes, a woman raised in a devout Catholic family in Iloilo, Philippines.

🔥 TESTIMONY:
“For over 25 years, I prayed to Mary more than I prayed to Jesus.
Every night, I held my rosary and whispered, ‘Please ask your Son for me.’
I believed what the Church told me: that Mary had power to influence Jesus.
We even celebrated her as the one who got Him to perform His first miracle.
The Chosen brought all those beliefs back.

When I saw the Cana episode… I felt validated.
I thought, ‘See? Even Jesus listens to His mother.’
But something didn’t sit right.
So I opened my Bible—and I saw something that shook my soul.

He said, ‘Woman, what have I to do with thee?’
That wasn’t honor… that was separation.
And when I read the Greek meaning, it all changed.

Mary didn’t initiate the miracle.
Jesus did.
Because of His own timeline. His own glory. His own authority.

I threw away my rosaries.
I stopped praying to Mary.
And now, for the first time in my life… I pray directly to the One who actually hears me.
The Son of God. The only Mediator.
Jesus Christ—my Lord and my Savior.”

📖 CONFIRMING SCRIPTURES:
1 Timothy 2:5 (KJV):
“For there is one God, and one mediator between God and men, the man Christ Jesus.”
John 14:6 (KJV):
“I am the way, the truth, and the life: no man cometh unto the Father, but by me.”

💣 False teaching leads sincere people into sincere bondage.
But when truth is revealed, chains are shattered.

✔ Jesus was not pressured by Mary.
✔ He was not maneuvered into miracles.
✔ He moved only by the will of the Father—and that’s the Jesus who saves.

FINAL CHALLENGE – WHO HOLDS THE AUTHORITY IN YOUR LIFE?
❓ READER QUESTION:
“Brother John, I love Jesus… but I still have deep respect for Mary. Is that wrong?”

Respect is one thing.
Reverence is another.
And when reverence for anyone begins to compete with the Lordship of Jesus Christ,
you’ve crossed from honor into heresy.

📖 SCRIPTURAL WARNING:
Matthew 10:37 (KJV):
“He that loveth father or mother more than me is not worthy of me…”

If Jesus said this about our own parents,
how much more should we beware when someone elevates His earthly mother above His divine will?

💣 The Chosen’s portrayal is subtle…
But subtle deception is the devil’s sharpest blade.
A Jesus who hesitates…
A Mary who moves Him…
A miracle that responds to emotion rather than the Father’s authority…

That’s not reverence.
That’s role reversal.

📖 WHO IS YOUR LORD?
✔ Is Jesus your Savior—but Mary still your intercessor?
✔ Do you trust the Word—or Catholic tradition?
✔ Do you follow Christ—or cling to cultural comfort?
“If ye continue in my word… ye shall know the truth, and the truth shall make you free.”

💥 THIS IS THE CROSSROAD:
The real Jesus doesn’t need your help to decide when to act.
He’s not waiting for Mary.
He’s not waiting for you.
He’s waiting for obedience.
And He’s calling:
“Follow Me.”

THE FOOL’S RESPONSE VS. THE WISE RESPONSE
📖 Proverbs 1:7 (KJV):
“The fear of the Lord is the beginning of knowledge: but fools despise wisdom and instruction.”

❌ THE FOOL’S RESPONSE:
“You’re overreacting—it’s just a story.”
“At least people are watching something about Jesus!”
“Mary is part of the story too—what’s the harm?”
“Stop being divisive. God uses imperfect media.”
“As long as it brings people closer to God, it’s okay!”

💣 Fools value emotion over authority.
Fools tolerate fiction when it makes them feel spiritual.
Fools believe false unity is more important than sound doctrine.

✅ THE WISE RESPONSE:
“If it’s not in the Bible, it doesn’t belong in my doctrine.”
“I want a Jesus who rules—not one who responds to pressure.”
“Mary is honored—but only Jesus is exalted.”
“I reject every false gospel—even the beautiful ones.”
“If a show rewrites the authority of Christ, I won’t support it.”
📖 Proverbs 9:10 (KJV):
“The fear of the Lord is the beginning of wisdom: and the knowledge of the holy is understanding.”

🔥 The wise are not moved by drama.
🔥 They are governed by Scripture.
🔥 They fear God—not culture.

WHAT IF YOU DIED TONIGHT?
❓ READER QUESTION:
“Brother John, is it really that serious? It’s just one scene about Mary and Jesus…”

Let me ask you:
What if tonight was your last scene?
No more episodes. No more posts.
Just you… standing before the Jesus who does not hesitate, does not stutter, and does not share His glory with anyone—not even Mary.
📖 Hebrews 9:27 (KJV):
“And as it is appointed unto men once to die, but after this the judgment.”

You will not stand before a soft-spoken wedding guest.
You will stand before the Lion of Judah.
Not the one who looked to Mary for timing,
But the One who said:
📖 John 10:18 (KJV):

“No man taketh it from me, but I lay it down of myself. I have power to lay it down,
and I have power to take it again. This commandment have I received of my Father.”
💣 If you died tonight…
Would you meet the Jesus who waits for Mary to nudge Him?
Or the Jesus who commands angels and nations with a word?
Would you come as a fan of a fictional Christ?
Or as a true disciple of the one who speaks and the wind obeys?

📖 Revelation 19:12–13 (KJV):
“His eyes were as a flame of fire… and his name is called The Word of God.”

Only one Jesus is coming back.
Not the TV version.
Not the Catholic-friendly one.
But the Biblical Jesus—and He’s not asking anyone’s permission.
📖 Romans 10:9 (KJV):

“That if thou shalt confess with thy mouth the Lord Jesus,
and shalt believe in thine heart that God hath raised him from the dead, thou shalt be saved.”

SATAN’S SNEAK ATTACKS – THE SPIRIT BEHIND MARIAN EXALTATION
❓ READER QUESTION:
“Brother John, do you really believe this portrayal of Mary is connected to end-time deception?”

🔥 Without question.
Because Satan doesn’t just use blasphemy—he uses beauty.
And the most dangerous deception is the one that looks holy, but undermines Christ’s authority.

💣 STRATEGY #1: REPLACE JESUS’ SOVEREIGNTY WITH “HOLY SUGGESTIONS”
"They have no wine…"
"Can’t you help, my son?"
That’s not submission. That’s subtle control.
📖 Isaiah 42:8 (KJV):
“I am the Lord: that is my name: and my glory will I not give to another…”

🔥 When Jesus looks like He’s obeying Mary, Satan plants the seed that He shares His throne.
That’s doctrinal treason.

💣 STRATEGY #2: ROMANIZE THE ROLE OF MARY INTO A MEDIATOR
Catholicism says:
“To Jesus through Mary.”
But Scripture says: 📖 1 Timothy 2:5 (KJV):
“There is one God, and one mediator between God and men, the man Christ Jesus.”

🛑 One mediator.
🛑 Not two. Not co-mediators. Not emotional influencers.
🛑 Only Christ.

💣 STRATEGY #3: PREPARE THE WORLD FOR A FALSE CHRIST
If the world gets used to a Jesus who…

✔ Listens to His mother’s suggestions
✔ Prioritizes emotion over mission
✔ Shares His glory with others
✔ Is loved by all and rejected by none...
Then the stage is set for a messiah who looks like Jesus—but is not Him.
📖 2 Thessalonians 2:4 (KJV):
“…who opposeth and exalteth himself… so that he as God sitteth in the temple of God, shewing himself that he is God.”

💣 The Antichrist will not offend Mary-loving crowds.
He will likely affirm her.

🔥 CONCLUSION:
✔️ Marian manipulation is not just error—it’s end-time infiltration.
✔️ The Jesus who listens to Mary cannot be the Jesus who reigns alone.
✔️ And the Church that tolerates this distortion is being groomed to accept a global false christ.

GOSPEL WARRIOR DECLARATION – FOR THOSE WHO REFUSE TO BOW TO A SHARED THRONE
❓ READER QUESTION:
“Brother John, how do I fully renounce this false version of Jesus and stand for truth?”

You declare war.
Not on people—but on deception.
You open your mouth and speak what hell fears most:
That you follow the Christ of Scripture, and no other.

🛡️ GOSPEL WARRIOR DECLARATION – SPEAK THIS OUT LOUD:
“Lord Jesus, I renounce every false gospel, every twisted portrayal, and every attempt to share Your glory.
I will not follow the Jesus of soft storytelling.
I will not bow to Mary, saints, systems, or emotions.
You alone are Lord.
You alone are King.
You alone are the One who commands my obedience.
I will not be deceived by beauty that contradicts the Bible.
I will not be seduced by media that dethrones Your majesty.
From this day forward, I will follow the Christ who reigns—not the Christ who hesitates.
I AM A GOSPEL WARRIOR.
And I will live, preach, and die for the TRUTH.
In the mighty name of Jesus—Amen.”
